_comment: Ticket 0318. The reviewed exceptions to the FULL-TREE npm audit gate (scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs). One entry per ADVISORY, never per path: npm reports ~37 high 'vulnerabilities' that are parent packages depending on these two leaves. Shape: { package, advisory (full GHSA id), severity (the highest severity admitted; a re-rating above it fails), owner, reason, recheck }. Every entry must still appear in the live audit: a stale entry fails the gate, so this file cannot accumulate dead exceptions. Admit nothing here without a decision; docs/capabilities/18-mvp-hardening.md's 0308 section is the review. The runtime tree has NO exceptions: `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` still runs beside this check.

advisories.reason: mergeDeep prototype pollution in the v6/v7/v9 copies under ampx's codegen (@aws-amplify/appsync-modelgen-plugin, graphql-generator, old @graphql-codegen/*). Dev tree only, run by pipeline-deploy over the project's own schema. No fix below 12.0.1: clearing it is a cross-major override inside Amplify's codegen, testable only by a real pipeline-deploy. @aws-amplify/backend-cli 1.10.0 still depends on these versions. 18-mvp-hardening.md, 0308 section.
advisories.recheck: Accepted risk (D-461): reviewed on any @aws-amplify/backend-cli upgrade past 1.10.0, when the stale-entry rule fires. Remove this entry when the advisory leaves the audit; the gate fails while a stale entry remains.

advisories.reason: Memory exhaustion on oversized collections in zod 3.25.x, which @aws-amplify/platform-core, cli-core, client-config and others pin exactly, and which data-construct and graphql-api-construct bundle (an override cannot rewrite a bundled tarball, D-162). No fixed 3.x; zod 4 is a breaking API. The inputs zod validates here are the project's own backend config, never a request. 18-mvp-hardening.md, 0308 section.
